rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bent-and-cantilevered mass in all four views, so it avoids the worst fragmentation and collision failures. However, the visible form is still predominantly a compact stacked block with a curved top and only a weakly articulated ground response to the verified access edge. The blue frontage edge is not answered by a clear public void, cut, or entry seam; the mass largely seals the edge rather than making an active threshold. The courtyard/terrace idea is present in the genotype, but it is not visually legible enough in the rendered mass to satisfy the neighborhood-living semantic contract. Sectionally, the silhouette suggests a sculpted roof and stacked volume, but not a convincing public-ground-plus-calm-upper hierarchy with usable open space. So the form is repairable and coherent, but not yet program-fit for the brief.
